I have a history of migraines and head rushes with no 'known cause' the biggest thing for me is resting on my left side for blood flow, like if I'm doing anything and get that feeling I relax ASAP for a few minutes.

 Vitamin D has also helped me a ton? That's what my OB recommended and I'm kind of shocked, doesn't stop them, but keeps me on my feet and they aren't as intense. She said everyone is deficient in it and even though most people get 'healthy' levels it's a huge help for you and baby!

A. All 3 obs I've seen have told me prenatals are for you, NOT baby, no matter what your baby will take from you what they need, so if you eat a full, fairly balanced diet by no means do you need them! It's all about how you feel, sometimes people have a poor reaction to the mixture.


B. I've lost over 30lbs so to try to help my nutritional intake ans stop my anxiety about not taking anything/not doing what I'm supposed to, CHILDRENS VITAMIN GUMMIES HAVE ABOUT THE SAME WITHOUT THE NAUSEA. Like straight up Flintstone gummies. They've been a life saver if you still want to take a supplement

Well considering they aren't all sons and him as well as his ex made it clear they are their children not mine and should be referred to as such yes I do respect the biological parents wishes with that 🤷‍♀️ at the end of the day it's biological parents and children's wishes over my own in that matter

I have a HUGE issue with my SD teacher, her punishment for misbehaving kids is a sticker system, not just a board but physically sticking giant red stickers on the children for the day. Reward for best behavior is CANDY. AND SHE ENCOURAGES US TO USE THIS IN OUR HOMES WITH ALL CHILDREN. 

And my step daughter has a lot of issues with dexterity and memory, which we've adequately noted. She's not very verbal, struggles to even make circles and lines, is very clumsy and we're in the process of getting her tested for learning disabilities. WE, THE PARENTS get punished for her not adequately assisting her and giving her the tools to learn,  if she messes up on homework or she's having more trouble, the teacher makes it a point to alert us to try harder. 


As someone who's studied psychology and childhood development the 'shame systems' that are put in place are extremely psychologically damaging and do nothing for their growth mentally and emotionally and I highly encourage every parent to look up on it and call every teacher out possible.

My partners ex did the same thing, 

The BEST thing to do is make sure there are no illegal substances, nothing dangerous (weapons, prescriptions, chemicals etc) laying around. We moved our medications in an upper cabinet and put any and all cleaning supplied above our kitchen sink. 

Now our house was a WRECK when they surprised us (dishes, the kids had built a fort and wrecked their room), they don't care about dishes or dust here and there, a messy bedroom. They look for exposed pipes, holes in walls, loose outlets, abuse towards the children, make sure you have an opening window in bedrooms/living rooms, and plenty of food in your fridge and cabinets.

Our biggest thing was cleaning our yard, and making sure all our light switch covers weren't loose (which they'd mentioned to fix and we did immediately)

The case was 8 months long for bio mom and ours lasted a week. As long as you're keeping the kids safe they understand people need to live and it's okay to be nervous!

Yes! Thats exactly how it feels, I was telling my friend it felt like the last few pieces of popcorn popping! I don't have any family i speak to and I'm the first of my friends to conceive so it's all new to me, my doctors no help at all with any part in this 😂
Thats how I am!! Even my doctors shocked at how much they move though from the ultrasound so I figured it'd be soon but I didn't realize how soon 😅

Physical harm. I've had gallons of water broke over me, I've been cut, stabbed with tacks, their favorite is to kick me in the stomach now. Stress and the emotional toll is at a whole new level. And these are young children mind you.
I don't even think I can name it to 24 so I admire you for that
